title: MIRAGE-CAD: Construction-Mediated Multimodal Generation of Executable CAD Programs
abstract: arXiv:2608.28669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recovering an executable parametric CAD program from an observed object is fundamentally ambiguous, because the same final geometry can result from different construction procedures. We study this problem from four types of input: natural-language descriptions, rendered images, point clouds, and STEP/B-Rep geometry. MIRAGE-CAD maps each input to a shared construction representation and mediates program generation through an explicit construction-plan interface. The resulting Python CAD code is executed by an OpenCASCADE kernel to build the solid and export it as STEP. On 2,500 held-out queries per modality, the system achieves 55.4-70.0% build success and 52.3-66.2% STEP export success without retrieval at inference. translated_title: MIRAGE-CAD：以构建过程为媒介的多模态可执行CAD程序生成
translated_abstract: 从观察到的物体中恢复可执行的参数化CAD程序在本质上是一个歧义问题，因为相同的最终几何形状可能来自不同的构建过程。我们从四种类型的输入研究这一问题：自然语言描述、渲染图像、点云以及STEP/B-Rep几何数据。MIRAGE-CAD将每种输入映射到一个共享的构建表示，并通过显式的构建计划接口来中介程序生成。生成的Python CAD代码由OpenCASCADE内核执行，以构建实体并将其导出为STEP格式。在每种模态各2,500个保留查询上，该系统在推理时无需检索即可达到55.4-70.0%的构建成功率和52.3-66.2%的STEP导出成功率。受控对比实验表明，强大的重建能力并不依赖于将构建表示以文本形式表达：直接以连续表示为条件的解码器同样能实现强大的重建，而……
tldr: MIRAGE-CAD提出一个以显式构建计划为媒介的多模态框架，将自然语言、图像、点云和B-Rep几何统一映射到共享构建表示并生成可执行的参数化CAD程序，在无需检索的情况下实现55.4-70.0%的构建成功率。
en_tdlr: MIRAGE-CAD introduces a multimodal framework that mediates the generation of executable parametric CAD programs through an explicit construction-plan interface, mapping language, images, point clouds, and B-Rep geometry onto a shared construction representation, achieving 55.4-70.0% build success without retrieval at inference.
